name: Explorer.exe
description: Binary used for managing files and system components within Windows
author: Jai Minton

commands.description: Execute specified .exe with the parent process spawning from a new instance of explorer.exe
commands.usecase: Performs execution of specified file with explorer parent process breaking the process tree, can be used for defense evasion.
commands.os: Windows XP, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Execute notepad.exe with the parent process spawning from a new instance of explorer.exe
commands.usecase: Performs execution of specified file with explorer parent process breaking the process tree, can be used for defense evasion.

detection: Multiple instances of explorer.exe or explorer.exe using the /root command line is suspicious.
